exact_mathematical_result.lemma: H_15 intersection P_16 is empty under the frozen C041 canonical grammar, equal split, literal-transpose row label 1||c, and unchanged C048 swapped reduction.
proof_core: The frozen k=15 selector exhausts canonical length-30 UNSAT-capable parents to v=1,m=3, width=1, with no padding.
For v=1 every literal variable-index field is the one-bit word 1. The 12-bit header is MAGIC||gamma(1)||gamma(3)=111001011011.
The equal split after 15 bits consumes the first three payload bits s1,1,s2. Hence c=1,s3,1,s4,1,s5,1,s6,1,s7,1,s8,1,s9,1 and 1||c has zero-indexed bit 3 equal to 1.
Every canonical length-32 current word begins MAGIC=11100101, so every prefix_16(y) has zero-indexed bit 3 equal to MAGIC[3]=0, in both frozen current parameter regimes.
Therefore 1||c cannot equal prefix_16(y) for any canonical length-30 parent and canonical length-32 current word. Restricting parents to the canonical-UNSAT subset preserves emptiness.
